resources.string: What Prepare does, and why preparing a game again is sometimes worth it. Shown once on the first start.
XRecomp translates a game\'s code into this device\'s own code, then runs it like an app made for Android. No game is included: you bring your own, from discs and cartridges you own.
A library folder: the app finds the games in it, whatever the console
Translates a game for this device, once, on the device itself
Saves, states, controls and settings, per game

Prepare reads the game\'s code, rewrites it as native code and compiles it here, on the device. It is done once per game and takes a while: a few minutes for a small game, much longer for a large one. Keep the device plugged in; your saves are never touched.
The game runs as native code instead of being interpreted instruction by instruction
The app\'s fixes for a game, its optional enhancements and resuming where you left off come with it
Xbox games play once prepared. Game Boy Advance, PS1 and N64 games play at once in the interpreter, and run natively once prepared

Reading the game finds most of its code, not all of it: some code is only reached while playing. When a game meets code the preparation missed, it goes on (slower there) and the app notes it. The next Prepare translates that code too, and it is quick: only what changed is compiled again.
The game\'s Home says so and offers Prepare again; Play stays meanwhile
A newer version translates games better: Prepare again gets its fixes
Another version of the disc, or the Enhancements setting turned on or off

You rarely have to think about it: with Self-healing on (Settings › General, on by default), the app prepares an Xbox game again by itself when a run found new code, and tells you in a note. You can stop it at any time.
The game is prepared again with what the crash revealed, then starts again by itself
It is improved in the background: you keep playing, the next start uses the new version
A crash with nothing new to learn: Home says the game needs a fix. This guide stays in Settings › General
